name: JHM Consolidation Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减、出售或获得合约的公告；已发布的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及股东授权相关文件。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长57.5%至117,525,000 MYR，净利润为6,169,000 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business segment expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins; announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, and shareholder mandate documents. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 57.5% year-on-year to MYR 117,525,000, with net profit of MYR 6,169,000.
